Early Translation Accelerator – ETA at Venture Center Skip to content Home About ETA How to Apply Industry Partners Main Menu Home About ETA How to Apply Industry Partners Call Extended!!! Apply by 3rd November 2023 Early Translation Accelerator at Venture Center For catalysing translation of innovative technologies from academia & research institutions into commercially viable ventures and technologies Apply Now Rapid Translation The Early Translation Accelerator (ETA) enables rapid translation of academic discoveries at technology readiness levels (TRL 4-5) into validated technologies (TRL 7-8) in association with industry partners. More About TRL Funded Projects ETA Projects are funded up to 90% with support from DBT-BIRAC providing an opportunity for de-risking technologies before technology transfer and facilitating co-development by academia-industries partnership. Project Funding Focus Areas Industrial Biotechnology-based Consumer Products: Skin Care & Personal Care Cosmeceuticals Functional Foods & Beverages Nutraceuticals , Health & Wellness Household Care About Focus Areas Technologies for Skin & Personal Care Technology Pitch Video (YouTube) Pullulan DR ANIRBAN ROY CHOUDHURY CSIR-IMTECH, CHANDIGARH Technology Pitch Presentation Technology Pitch Video (YouTube) Cetearyl Alcohol DR SYED SHAMS YAZDANI DBT-ICGEB, DELHI Technology Pitch Presentation Technology Pitch

How to Apply – Early Translation Accelerator Skip to content Home About ETA How to Apply Industry Partners Main Menu Home About ETA How to Apply Industry Partners Apply for ETA Who Can Apply? Inventors & Research Scientists from Universities, Academic and Research Institutions in India working on novel sustainable biotechnology products with application in consumer goods. How To Apply? All applicants can apply online by filling the form: https://forms.gle/Q7b49feC1aPB5bAs7 and uploading requested documents. For more details on ETA, download Programme Outline: http://bit.ly/eta-outline Benefits of Applying Opportunity for de-risking and development of technologies for enhancing their commercialisation prospects. Scale-up of novel bioprocesses and innovative technologies as funded projects with support from BIRAC and industry partners. Realising commercial potential of technologies with significant societal and market relevance. Helping industry address current global demand for sustainable technologies and green products. Fostering a robust innovation ecosystem in India by promoting collaboration between academia, research institutions and industries. Programme Plan Phases of the ETA Programme: Phase 1 – SELECTION: Call opens; Technology submissions received; Eligibility check including technical feasibility and due diligence; Shortlisting; Identifying industrial partners;
